title: 第十三章 评估垫底第十四章 初赛开启对阵祝山
slug: 震惊五星灵帝被逼着撩妹
lines: 第二天一早，星澜宗广场南侧的告示栏前，已经围满了人。
初赛名单公示了。
密密麻麻的名字按照修为和宗门内部排位依次排列，从上到下，一目了然。榜首是内定准圣子林浩，三星灵尊入灵境，名字后面还特意标注了一个“种子选手”的标签。紧随其后的是赵冲、墨尘、周玄等一众内门顶尖天才。
所有人都在榜单上扫视着，想找一个名字——
杨卤。
“找到了！在这里！”一个眼尖的弟子突然喊道，手指着榜单的最下方。
所有人的目光顺着他手指的方向看去。
榜单末尾，最后一行，赫然写着两个字——
杨卤。
排在倒数第一。
广场上安静了一秒，然后爆发出震天响的哄笑声。
“哈哈哈哈！倒数第一！这就是那个神谕灵天才？”
“我就说他没了那戒指什么都不是！现在真面目露出来了吧！”
“初赛榜单按综合实力排的，他排倒数第一，说明宗门长老都觉得他最弱！”
“笑死我了，昨天还那么嚣张地摘戒指，今天就原形毕露了！”
人群中的嘲讽声此起彼伏，一张张脸上写满了幸灾乐祸。
杨卤站在人群外围，双手抱胸，面无表情地看着告示栏上自己那个孤零零的名字，嘴角微微抽动了一下。
排倒数第一？
他倒是不在意这个排名，毕竟他知道自己的真实实力。
但问题是，系统明文规定了，他最多只能动用二星灵王入灵境上限的实力，也就是说，他必须把五星灵帝的实力完全压制住，纯粹靠二星灵王的底子去打。
这就有点麻烦了。
倒不是怕打不过，而是怕一不小心没收住力，把对手打死了，那就不好交代了。
“杨卤！”
一个声音从人群中传来，语气中满是挑衅。
杨卤抬眼看去，只见一个身材魁梧的弟子从人群中走出来，正是昨天被杨卤灌醉的刘万。他脸上还带着宿醉过后的疲惫，但眼神中满是兴奋——仿佛终于逮到了报复的机会。
“看到没？你排倒数第一！”刘万指着告示栏，大声说道，“没了那枚戒指，你就是个废物！还敢参加比武？我劝你趁早弃权，免得在台上丢人现眼！”
周围弟子纷纷附和：“就是！弃权吧！别丢人了！”
“你一个倒数第一，上去也是被人一招秒的命！”
“我要是你，现在就跪地求饶，求长老别把你编进对战表里！”
杨卤看着这群叫嚣的弟子，嘴角缓缓上扬，露出一丝玩味的笑容。
他缓缓开口：“既然你们都这么说，那……要不要来个盘外赌？”
盘外赌？
三个字一出，原本喧闹的广场瞬间安静了几分。
所有人都愣住了。
什么情况？
他都排倒数第一了，还敢主动提赌约？
刘万也是一愣：“你……你要赌什么？”
content_en:
Early the next morning, the notice board on the south side of Xinglan Sect Square was already crowded with people.
The preliminary round list has been announced.
The densely packed names are arranged in order according to their cultivation level and the internal ranking of the sect. From top to bottom, it is clear at a glance. At the top of the list is Lin Hao, the pre-determined quasi-holy son, a three-star spiritual master who has entered the spiritual realm. There is also a label of "seed player" behind his name. Following closely behind were Zhao Chong, Mo Chen, Zhou Xuan and other top geniuses from the inner sect.
Everyone was scanning the list, trying to find a name——
Yang Lu.
"Found it! Here!" A sharp-eyed disciple suddenly shouted, pointing to the bottom of the list.
Everyone looked in the direction of his finger.
At the end of the list, in the last line, two words were written -
Yang Lu.
Ranked last.
The square was quiet for a second, and then burst into loud laughter.
"Hahahaha! The last one! Is this the oracle spirit genius?"
"I just said he is nothing without the ring! Now his true colors are revealed!"
"The preliminary list is based on overall strength, and he ranks last, which shows that the elders of the sect think he is the weakest!"
"I'm laughing so hard. Yesterday I was so arrogant about taking off my ring, but today my true colors are revealed!"
The crowd jeered one after another, with gloating written all over their faces.
Yang Lu stood outside the crowd, folding his arms and looking at his lonely name on the bulletin board expressionlessly, with a slight twitch in the corner of his mouth.
Ranked last?
He doesn't care about this ranking, after all, he knows his true strength.
But the problem is that the system clearly stipulates that he can only use the maximum strength of the two-star spiritual king to enter the spiritual realm. In other words, he must completely suppress the strength of the five-star spiritual emperor and rely solely on the foundation of the two-star spiritual king.
This is a bit troublesome.
It's not that I'm afraid that I won't be able to defeat you, but I'm afraid that if I accidentally lose my strength and kill my opponent, it will be difficult to explain.
"Yang Lu!"
A voice came from the crowd, his tone full of provocation.
Yang Lu looked up and saw a burly disciple walking out of the crowd. It was Liu Wan who was drunk by Yang Lu yesterday. His face still looked tired after a hangover, but his eyes were full of excitement - as if he had finally caught a chance for revenge.
"Did you see that? You are ranked last!" Liu Wan pointed at the notice board and said loudly, "Without that ring, you are a waste! Do you still dare to participate in the competition? I advise you to abstain as soon as possible to avoid embarrassment on the stage!"
The surrounding disciples all echoed: "That's right! Give up! Don't be embarrassed!"
"You are the last one, and you will be killed in a matter of seconds if you go up!"
"If I were you, I would kneel down and beg for mercy right now, and beg the elders not to put you on the battle list!"
Yang Lu looked at the clamoring disciples, and the corners of his mouth slowly raised, revealing a playful smile.
He spoke slowly: "Since you all said so, then... do you want to make an off-market bet?"
Off-market betting?
As soon as these three words came out, the originally noisy square instantly became quiet.
Everyone was stunned.
What's going on?
He is ranked last, yet he still dares to propose a bet?
Liu Wan was also stunned: "You...what are you betting on?"
